text: Once upon a time, two brothers set off on a journey together.
They rested under a tree at noon, and when they woke up, they saw a mysterious stone beside them.
On the stone was an inscription: "Whoever finds this stone, let him go straight into the forest at sunrise.
There, a river will appear.
Swim across it, and you will find a bear and her cubs.
Take the cubs and run up the mountain without looking back.
At the top of the mountain, a house awaits you, and inside, happiness."
The younger brother was excited and immediately said, "Let's go together!
We can do this!
We'll cross the river, carry the cubs, and find the happiness we're meant to have."
But the elder brother was cautious.
"You don't know if this is true.
What if we get lost?
What if the river is too dangerous?
Or what if the bear attacks us?
And what if the happiness we find isn't what we expect?"
The younger brother disagreed.
"I think we should go! Who else will find happiness if we don't try? Plus, we'll never know if we don't take a chance."
The elder brother said, "I'll stay here. You can go, but be careful!"

text: The younger brother set off alone.
At sunrise, he found the river.
It was swift, but he was a strong swimmer.
He crossed it without hesitation and reached the other side.
There, he found the bear and her cubs, fast asleep.
He remembered the instructions and carefully took the cubs, then started running up the mountain without looking back.
After climbing the mountain, the younger brother was greeted by the townspeople
who welcomed him with a carriage and made him their king.
For five years, he ruled with wisdom.
But in the sixth year, another king came with a stronger army and conquered the city.
The younger brother was forced to flee.
After losing his kingdom, the younger brother did not regret his journey.

text: Wandering once more, the younger brother arrived at the elder brother's house.
The elder brother had remained in the village, living a steady, peaceful life.
The two brothers reunited and began to share their stories.
The elder brother said, "You see, I was right.
I stayed here and lived calmly, while you, even though you were once a king, have had nothing but trouble."
The younger brother smiled and replied, "I may not have a kingdom now,
but I have stories, adventures, and lessons I'll never forget.
You may have avoided the challenges, but you'll never have the memories I carry with me."
The elder brother values peace and stability, while the younger brother cherishes the memories and lessons of his adventures.
